shared_elements: bearded male figures in strict profile
horses in profile with harness trappings
overlapping figures in file receding one behind another
low-relief figures aligned on a common ground line
horizontal band of repeated ornament (rosette band in A; scale/wave field in B)
figures holding long staffs or rods
justification: Both surfaces depict rows of bearded men in strict profile with tall distinctive headgear, rendered in shallow relief with overlapping bodies and long held rods, alongside profile horses with harness trappings, and both use a repeated ornamental band/filler field as a boundary — conventions specific enough to look kindred. The biggest difference in content is the action: A is a static multi-register procession of standing figures and led animals, while B is a single dynamic scene of harnessed horses drawing a wheeled chariot with armed occupants over a schematic field of hills and water with fish.
